text_block_list.text:
One day, a few days after the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

Tamamo Cross regrets that her own mistake 
was what caused Super Creek to get 
completely serious.

After hearing the story, the Trainer 
realized that Super Creek had gotten 
serious simply because Tamamo Cross was 
trying to hurt the Trainer.

Because of this, the Trainer prayed that 
Super Creek would be able to run calmly in 
her next race.
